newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH JAN-AUG NEW CAR SALES SURGE 50 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: CZECH JAN-AUG NEW CAR SALES SURGE 50 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Total new passenger car sales in the Czech Republic surged 50 percent in the first eight months of 1996 to 100,715 units, the Czech Association of Car Importers said on Thursday.

The association said that passenger car imports, excluding imports by individuals, leapt by a year-on-year rate of 79 percent in the period to 45,566 units from 25,437 in the first eight months of 1995.
The domestic car producer, Skoda Automobilova a.s., a unit of Volkswagen AG increased its sales by 32 percent in the period to 55,095 passenger cars from 41,667, it said.
Total sales of light utility vehicles rose 15 percent to 12,042 units from 10,480 on a 35 percent rise of imports and 13 percent drop of sales of domestic cars.
Opel led import sales during the period with a total of 7,238 passenger and utility vehicles, followed by Ford with 6,940 units.
